column1: # Notes: the offset of the partition table itself is set in
# $IDF_PATH/components/partition_table/Kconfig.projbuild.
# Fluispotter IMG-9: a 64 KiB coredump partition carved from the UNUSED TAIL
# of factory.  factory ran 0x10000..0x200000 and butted directly against vfs
# so the space had to come out of factory: 0x1F0000 -> 0x1E0000.
# vfs THEREFORE DOES NOT MOVE.  It must not: the event store lives there and
# the flash-preservation guarantee (spec 7.8) depends on that offset.
# Headroom after the shrink: the app image is ~0x1A6640 (spec 5.9.4)
# leaves ~230 KiB free inside the smaller factory.
# bootstat.py carries _FACTORY_OFFSET/_FACTORY_SIZE copies of the factory row
# to identify the bootloader's rtc_retain_mem_t block before trusting its
# reboot counter.  A cross-file test pins the two together — change this row
# and that file changes with it
# Name
nvs
phy_init
factory
coredump
vfs
